question: Mangubhai Chhaganbhai Patel was appointed as the Governor of ____________ in July 2021.
solution:
The correct answer is __Madhya Pradesh__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Mangubhai Chhaganbhai Patel is an Indian statesman who is the current and 19th Governor of Madhya Pradesh.
 
• He is a leader of the BJP from Gujarat.
 
• He served as the officiating speaker of the Gujarat Legislative Assembly in 2014.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• He has earlier served as a cabinet minister in the Government of Gujarat.
 
• The primary function of the governor is to preserve, protect and defend the constitution.
 
• The law is incorporated in their oath of office under Article 159.
